This is going to sound weird but hear me out: everything I try or do.

Throughout my life I’m just good at anything I try but I have no motivation to want to do any of it. I got straight A’s in highschool but I didn’t put any effort in, hell in my maths GSCE I didn’t even submit one of the two coursework’s you had to do but my teacher “pretended” I did and prayed they didn’t ask for mine when they sent off because she liked me I guess, like everyone likes me because I’m easy to get along with and laid back.

I didn’t try in college and got two A’s and a B. I stopped going for 3 weeks and pretended I was going to my mum until one of the tutors called home to ask where I was. I didn’t go to uni because I didn’t want to; instead i took a job working for a betting company taking bets over the phone. They have a 2 week course and a test you have to pass afterwards to get you into the place (to then train to get onto the phone lines). I did the test after 3 days and was literally on the phone taking bets with real customers on the 4th.

4 months later I got promoted to customer service, trained for 2 days on their system and was working there properly on the 3rd, it usually takes about a week before they let anyone start unsupervised. From there I got promoted to become a junior sports trader (the guys who compile the odds, despite no mathematical experience since high school). I did that for a year and got bored and literally left to do nothing.

I worked in a bar and became assistant manager within 8 months, then left because I didn’t want to do it anymore.

I joined a contract catering company as a potwash with zero cooking experience. That was 4 years ago. Next week I become Area support (basically the area managers right hand man) for a region in the north west.  

Nothing motivates me, I’m just good at whatever I try. I did one of my girlfriends university English papers because she was stressed. It took me 4 hours and it got 81/100. 

I ran a marathon within 3 months of starting the couch to 5k programme. I learned how to play guitar in 2 months and haven’t played it since I finished my first full song. 

My issue is I don’t want to do any of this stuff, I want to sit at home and do nothing. I have no motivation to want to get better but I still end up advancing and bettering myself without trying. They’re just jobs or hobbies that mean nothing to me. 

This was a long ass post and I’m sorry if you actually read it all, it probably reads like one massive fucking humble brag but honestly believe me when I say I’m not proud of any of that shit I’m genuinely just answering the question.
